---
title: "behavior-endpoints"
subtitle: "Behavioral endpoints (total distance, distance change, distance shift, movement similarity), normalized per plate, with dose-response plots"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  warning: true
  message: false
params:
  # All values come from behavior-endpoints.yml (--execute-params); defaults
  # are null on purpose (nested-map defaults are not valid knitr params).
  run_label: null
  project_root: "../../.."
  upstream: null
  segments: null
  similarity_segments: null
  similarity_metrics: null
  normalization: null
  layout: null
  chemical_col: null
  title_cols: null
  title_wrap_width: null
  panel_order: null
  ncol: null
  pdf_width: null
  pdf_height_per_row: null
---

<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/behavior-endpoints/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in behavior-endpoints.yml and render with:

  quarto render behavior-endpoints.qmd --execute-params behavior-endpoints.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions. See
inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md for the run-folder / naming / manifest rules.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)

p <- params
skill <- "behavior-endpoints"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}
as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
or_default <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
num <- function(x, default, what, lower = -Inf, integer = FALSE) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(or_default(x, default)))
  if (length(v) != 1 || !is.finite(v) || v < lower || (integer && v != round(v))) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` must be ", if (integer) "an integer" else "a number",
                      if (is.finite(lower)) paste0(" >= ", lower) else "", "."))
  }
  v
}
parse_segments <- function(x, what) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` is required (confirm with the user)."))
  out <- lapply(names(x), function(nm) {
    s <- x[[nm]]
    if (!is.list(s) || is.null(s$from) || is.null(s$to)) {
      stop_param(paste0(what, " `", nm, "` must be given as {from: <first>, to: <last>}."))
    }
    from <- as.numeric(s$from)
    to <- as.numeric(s$to)
    if (length(from) != 1 || length(to) != 1 || !is.finite(from) || !is.finite(to) || to < from) {
      stop_param(paste0(what, " `", nm, "` needs numeric from <= to."))
    }
    seq(from, to)
  })
  names(out) <- names(x)
  all_t <- unlist(out, use.names = FALSE)
  if (anyDuplicated(all_t)) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` overlap at time_value(s): ",
                      paste(unique(all_t[duplicated(all_t)]), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  out
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
upstream_runs <- sub("/+$", "", as_chr(p$upstream))
if (length(upstream_runs) == 0) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list one dataset-import-qc run (plus optional QC runs).")
}
segments <- parse_segments(p$segments, "segments")
similarity_segments <- parse_segments(p$similarity_segments, "similarity_segments")
similarity_metrics <- or_default(as_chr(p$similarity_metrics), "spearman")
bad_metric <- setdiff(similarity_metrics, c("spearman", "pearson", "cosine", "euclidean"))
if (length(bad_metric) > 0) stop_param(paste0("unknown similarity metric(s): ", paste(bad_metric, collapse = ", ")))

default_norm <- list(total_distance = "log_diff", distance_change_shift = "none", movement_similarity = "ratio")
normalization <- if (is.null(p$normalization)) list() else as.list(p$normalization)
bad_norm_type <- setdiff(names(normalization), names(default_norm))
if (length(bad_norm_type) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("unknown endpoint type(s) in `normalization`: ", paste(bad_norm_type, collapse = ", ")))
}
normalization <- lapply(normalization, as.character)
norm_used <- utils::modifyList(default_norm, normalization)

layout <- or_default(p$layout, "per_plate")
if (!layout %in% c("per_plate", "by_chemical_pooled")) {
  stop_param("`layout` must be per_plate or by_chemical_pooled.")
}
chemical_col <- or_default(as_chr(p$chemical_col), "DTXSID")
title_cols <- as_chr(p$title_cols)
title_wrap_width <- num(p$title_wrap_width, 40, "title_wrap_width", lower = 1)
panel_order <- or_default(p$panel_order, "alphabetical")
if (!panel_order %in% c("alphabetical", "group_key")) {
  stop_param("`panel_order` must be alphabetical or group_key.")
}
n_col <- num(p$ncol, 4, "ncol", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
pdf_width <- num(p$pdf_width, 15, "pdf_width", lower = 1)
pdf_height_per_row <- num(p$pdf_height_per_row, 2.2, "pdf_height_per_row", lower = 0.5)

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
for (f in list.files(out_dir, pattern = paste0("^", skill, "__", p$run_label, "__"), full.names = TRUE)) {
  file.remove(f)
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))

has_reactable <- requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)
show_table <- function(df, page_size = 15) {
  if (has_reactable) {
    reactable::reactable(df, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
                         defaultPageSize = page_size, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Run

- Skill: `behavior-endpoints`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- Layout: **`r layout`**`r if (layout != "per_plate") paste0(" (chemical column: ", chemical_col, ")") else ""`
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Upstream

Exactly one `complete` `dataset-import-qc` run (single-larva wells only),
plus optional `complete` QC runs of that same import whose `excluded_plates`
are dropped (`CONVENTIONS.md`, section 6).

```{r}
#| label: upstream

read_manifest <- function(run) {
  dir <- file.path(project_root, run)
  f <- list.files(file.path(dir, "outputs"), pattern = "__manifest\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) != 1) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints: no unique manifest found in ", file.path(dir, "outputs"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  m <- yaml::read_yaml(f)
  if (!identical(m$status, "complete")) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints: upstream run `", run, "` has status `", m$status,
         "`, not `complete`. Resolve it first (", m$status_reason, ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  m$.run <- run
  m$.manifest_file <- f
  m
}
ups <- lapply(upstream_runs, read_manifest)
up_skills <- vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$skill), "")
if (sum(up_skills == "dataset-import-qc") != 1) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list exactly one dataset-import-qc run.")
}
imp <- ups[[which(up_skills == "dataset-import-qc")]]
qc_runs <- ups[up_skills != "dataset-import-qc"]
if (!identical(imp$well_contract, "single_larva_wells_only")) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints: the import manifest does not declare `well_contract: ",
       "single_larva_wells_only`. Re-run dataset-import-qc with the current skill.", call. = FALSE)
}
for (m in qc_runs) {
  qc_up <- vapply(m$upstream, function(u) sub("/+$", "", as.character(u$run)), "")
  if (!imp$.run %in% qc_up) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints: QC run `", m$.run, "` (", m$skill, ") was made on ",
         paste(qc_up, collapse = ", "), ", not on the import run `", imp$.run, "`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
imp_outputs <- data.frame(
  path = vapply(imp$outputs, `[[`, "", "path"),
  md5 = vapply(imp$outputs, `[[`, "", "md5"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
combined_rel <- imp_outputs$path[grepl("__combined\\.rds$", imp_outputs$path)]
if (length(combined_rel) != 1) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints: import manifest lists no combined.rds output.", call. = FALSE)
}
combined_file <- file.path(project_root, imp$.run, combined_rel)
md5_now <- md5(combined_file)
md5_drift <- !identical(md5_now, imp_outputs$md5[imp_outputs$path == combined_rel])
if (md5_drift) {
  warning("Upstream combined.rds md5 differs from its manifest: the import run was ",
          "modified after it completed. Confirm with the user before using these results.",
          call. = FALSE)
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  upstream = vapply(ups, `[[`, "", ".run"),
  skill = up_skills,
  status = vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$status), ""),
  excluded_plates = vapply(ups, function(m) length(m$excluded_plates), 1L)
), caption = paste0("Upstream runs. combined.rds md5 matches its manifest: ", !md5_drift, "."))
```

```{r}
#| label: load

combined <- readRDS(combined_file)
qc_excl <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), qc_run = character(0))),
  lapply(qc_runs, function(m) {
    if (length(m$excluded_plates) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      plate_id = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$plate_id), ""),
      reason = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$reason), ""),
      qc_run = m$.run, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
))
unknown_excl <- setdiff(qc_excl$plate_id, combined$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_excl) > 0) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints: QC-excluded plate(s) not in the import data: ",
       paste(unknown_excl, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
d <- combined[!combined$plate_id %in% qc_excl$plate_id, , drop = FALSE]

by_chem <- layout == "by_chemical_pooled"
id_cols <- unique(c(if (by_chem) chemical_col, title_cols))
id_cols <- setdiff(id_cols, c("plate_id", "well_id", "chemical_id", "concentration", "concentration_unit",
                              "keep_well", "is_vehicle_control"))
missing_cols <- setdiff(c(behavior_endpoint_input_cols(), "chemical_id", "concentration", id_cols, title_cols),
                        names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("column(s) not in the upstream data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
na_cols <- id_cols[vapply(id_cols, function(cc) anyNA(d[[cc]]), TRUE)]
if (length(na_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("column(s) with missing values cannot identify plates/chemicals: ",
                    paste(na_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
times <- sort(unique(d$time_value))
for (what in c("segments", "similarity_segments")) {
  st <- unlist(get(what), use.names = FALSE)
  miss <- setdiff(st, times)
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0(what, " time_value(s) not present in the data: ", paste(utils::head(miss, 10), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

# Endpoints use kept wells only, with missing distance values set to 0
# (the same rule as raw-response-plots' impute_zero and the validated method).
eligible <- d[d$keep_well, , drop = FALSE]
endpoint_input <- replace_na_response_zero(eligible)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates_in_import = length(unique(combined$plate_id)),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = length(unique(qc_excl$plate_id)),
  plates_used = length(unique(d$plate_id)),
  kept_wells = nrow(unique(eligible[, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
  keep_well_false_wells_not_used = nrow(unique(d[!d$keep_well, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
  missing_values_set_to_0 = sum(is.na(eligible$response_value)),
  timepoints = length(times)
), caption = "Data used for endpoints (kept wells only).")
if (nrow(qc_excl) > 0) knitr::kable(qc_excl, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plates excluded by upstream QC runs.")
```

## Endpoints

`generate_behavior_endpoints()` computes, per well, total distance (area
under the movement curve per segment), distance change (`both`: area of
|well - plate VC median trace|) and distance shift (`up` / `down`: area above
/ below it) per segment, and movement similarity (mean correlation with the
plate's VC wells) per similarity window. Each value is normalized per plate
against the plate's vehicle-control median.

```{r}
#| label: settings

seg_tbl <- data.frame(
  window = c(paste0(names(segments), " (phase)"), paste0(names(similarity_segments), " (similarity)")),
  from = c(vapply(segments, min, 1), vapply(similarity_segments, min, 1)),
  to = c(vapply(segments, max, 1), vapply(similarity_segments, max, 1))
)
knitr::kable(seg_tbl, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Endpoint windows (time_value, inclusive).")
norm_tbl <- data.frame(
  endpoint_type = names(norm_used),
  normalization = unlist(norm_used),
  default = unlist(default_norm[names(norm_used)]),
  is_default = unlist(norm_used) == unlist(default_norm[names(norm_used)])
)
knitr::kable(norm_tbl, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
  "Normalization per endpoint type; similarity metric(s): ", paste(similarity_metrics, collapse = ", "), "."
))
if (!all(norm_tbl$is_default)) {
  cat("NOTE: non-default normalization for:", paste(norm_tbl$endpoint_type[!norm_tbl$is_default], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: generate

cor_warnings <- character(0)
endpoints <- withCallingHandlers(
  generate_behavior_endpoints(
    endpoint_input,
    auc_segments = segments,
    similarity_segments = similarity_segments,
    similarity_metrics = similarity_metrics,
    normalization = normalization,
    extra_id_cols = id_cols
  ),
  warning = function(w) {
    cor_warnings <<- c(cor_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }
)
validation <- validate_behavior_endpoints(
  endpoints,
  source_d = endpoint_input,
  expected_endpoint_types = c("total_distance", "distance_change_shift", "movement_similarity")
)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  rows = nrow(endpoints),
  wells = nrow(unique(endpoints[, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
  endpoints = length(unique(endpoints$endpoint)),
  na_normalized = sum(is.na(endpoints$endpoint_value_norm)),
  warnings_captured = length(cor_warnings)
), caption = "Endpoint table.")
if (length(cor_warnings) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(warning = cor_warnings), responseName = "n"),
               caption = "Warnings during calculation (e.g. zero-variance wells in movement similarity; their similarity is set to 0).")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-validation

knitr::kable(as.data.frame(validation$checks)[, c("code", "status", "message", "n_affected")], row.names = FALSE,
             caption = paste0("Structural validation (validate_behavior_endpoints): ",
                              if (isTRUE(validation$ok)) "passed" else "FAILED", "."))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-inventory

inv <- stats::aggregate(
  endpoint_value_norm ~ endpoint_type + endpoint + normalization_method,
  data = as.data.frame(endpoints[!endpoints$is_vehicle_control, ]),
  FUN = function(v) round(stats::median(v), 2)
)
names(inv)[4] <- "median_normalized_treated"
inv <- inv[order(match(inv$endpoint_type, c("total_distance", "distance_change_shift", "movement_similarity")),
                 inv$endpoint), ]
knitr::kable(inv, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Endpoints (median normalized value of treated wells).")
```

## Dose-response plots

Four PDFs, one per endpoint group, normalized values; one panel per
`r if (by_chem) "chemical (points coloured by plate)" else "plate"`, one row
per endpoint (in segment order), `r n_col` panels per page, panels in
`r panel_order` order. The vehicle control is the first box (`VC`).

```{r}
#| label: plots

seg_names <- names(segments)
sim_names <- as.vector(outer(names(similarity_segments), similarity_metrics, paste, sep = "_"))
groups <- list(
  `total-distance` = list(
    rows = seg_names,
    y = "total distance (normalized)"
  ),
  `distance-change` = list(
    rows = paste0(seg_names, "@both_auc"),
    y = "distance change (normalized)"
  ),
  `distance-shift` = list(
    rows = as.vector(rbind(paste0(seg_names, "@down_auc"), paste0(seg_names, "@up_auc"))),
    y = "distance shift (normalized)"
  ),
  `movement-similarity` = list(
    rows = sim_names,
    y = "movement similarity (normalized)"
  )
)

plot_base <- as.data.frame(endpoints)
key_col <- if (by_chem) chemical_col else "plate_id"
tcols <- if (length(title_cols) > 0) title_cols else key_col
plot_base$plot_title <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(tcols, function(cc) as.character(plot_base[[cc]])), sep = " | "))
titles <- unique(plot_base[, c(key_col, "plot_title")])
if (anyDuplicated(titles[[key_col]])) {
  stop_param(paste0("`title_cols` must be constant within each panel (", key_col, ")."))
}
key_levels <- if (panel_order == "alphabetical") {
  titles[[key_col]][order(tolower(titles$plot_title), titles$plot_title, method = "radix")]
} else {
  sort(as.character(titles[[key_col]]))
}
plot_base$panel_key <- factor(as.character(plot_base[[key_col]]), levels = as.character(key_levels))

pdf_info <- data.frame(pdf = character(0), endpoints = integer(0), pages = integer(0), height_in = numeric(0))
first_pages <- list()
for (g in names(groups)) {
  rows <- groups[[g]]$rows
  dg <- plot_base[plot_base$endpoint %in% rows, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(dg) == 0) next
  pages <- plot_behavior_dose_response_pages(
    dg,
    group_cols = "panel_key",
    title_col = "plot_title",
    endpoint_order = rows,
    point_colour_col = if (by_chem) "plate_id" else NULL,
    y_label = groups[[g]]$y,
    title_wrap_width = title_wrap_width,
    nrow = 1,
    ncol = n_col
  )
  height <- 1.5 + pdf_height_per_row * length(unique(dg$endpoint))
  f <- out_path(g, "pdf")
  grDevices::pdf(f, width = pdf_width, height = height)
  for (pg in pages) {
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(pg)
  }
  invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
  first_pages[[g]] <- list(page = pages[[1]], height = height)
  pdf_info <- rbind(pdf_info, data.frame(pdf = f, endpoints = length(unique(dg$endpoint)),
                                         pages = length(pages), height_in = height))
}
knitr::kable(pdf_info, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0("PDFs written (", length(key_levels),
                                                            " panels each, width ", pdf_width, " in)."))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-first-pages
#| fig-cap: "First page of the total-distance PDF."
#| fig-width: !expr pdf_width
#| fig-height: !expr first_pages[["total-distance"]]$height

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(first_pages[["total-distance"]]$page)
```

## Status and outputs

```{r}
#| label: save

if (isTRUE(validation$ok)) {
  status <- "complete"
  status_reason <- paste0(length(unique(endpoints$plate_id)), " plate(s), ",
                          nrow(unique(endpoints[, c("plate_id", "well_id")])), " wells, ",
                          length(unique(endpoints$endpoint)), " endpoints. Inspect the PDFs.")
} else {
  status <- "failed"
  bad <- validation$checks$code[validation$checks$status %in% c("failed", "ambiguous")]
  status_reason <- paste0("Structural validation failed: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
                          ". See the validation table; do not use these endpoints.")
}

save_rds(endpoints, out_path("endpoints", "rds"))
save_rds(validation, out_path("endpoint-validation", "rds"))
outputs <- c(out_path("endpoints", "rds"), out_path("endpoint-validation", "rds"), pdf_info$pdf)

manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  upstream = lapply(ups, function(m) list(
    run = m$.run, skill = m$skill,
    manifest = file.path(m$.run, "outputs", basename(m$.manifest_file)), status = m$status
  )),
  inputs = list(list(path = file.path(imp$.run, combined_rel), md5 = md5_now,
                     md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !md5_drift)),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  method = list(
    wells = "keep_well == TRUE; missing response values set to 0 (replace_na_response_zero)",
    segments = lapply(segments, function(s) c(min(s), max(s))),
    similarity_segments = lapply(similarity_segments, function(s) c(min(s), max(s))),
    similarity_metrics = similarity_metrics,
    normalization = norm_used,
    non_default_normalization = as.list(norm_tbl$endpoint_type[!norm_tbl$is_default]),
    extra_id_cols = as.list(id_cols),
    validation_ok = isTRUE(validation$ok)
  ),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = lapply(seq_len(nrow(qc_excl)), function(i) as.list(qc_excl[i, ])),
  summary = list(
    n_plates = length(unique(endpoints$plate_id)),
    n_wells = nrow(unique(endpoints[, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
    n_endpoints = length(unique(endpoints$endpoint)),
    n_rows = nrow(endpoints),
    n_panels = length(key_levels),
    pdfs = lapply(seq_len(nrow(pdf_info)), function(i) list(pdf = basename(pdf_info$pdf[i]), pages = pdf_info$pages[i]))
  ),
  parameters = p
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))
```

**Status: `r status`.** `r status_reason`

```{r}
#| label: outputs

knitr::kable(data.frame(output = c(outputs, out_path("manifest", "yml"))),
             caption = "Files written by this run.")
```
